messages:
Carmen: Heads up — EU-west dedicated pool 12 is spiking tail latencies ~3-4x since 02:10 UTC. graphs show NIC tx drops and one tenant (tenant-9204) is dominating egress. possible noisy neighbor.
Ryan: Can you paste the flow dump or src/dst?
Carmen: quick tcpdump snippet: 
```
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -nn 'host 10.0.3.42 and (tcp[tcpflags] & tcp-push != 0)' -c 100
# many long-lived flows to 52.46.12.8:443 and sustained packets/sec ~120k
```
Linh: That pattern smells like KV-cache regen / bulk prefetching. Tenant-9204 rolled a new warmer yesterday at 01:45 UTC, maybe runaway prefetch.
Ryan: Short-term mitigation: apply tc egress shaping per-tenant mark on the node to cap to 500Mbps so the rest of the slice isn't starved.
Devex-Sam: Note: tenant-9204 has dedicated capacity SLA, we can't throttle their traffic without ops/handshake. Quarantining to a noisy-silo might be better.
Ana: Agree. If we migrate them to a noisy-silo ring (fractional/sandbox slice) we preserve SLA semantics but isolate the noise. Ops — any spare capacity in eu-west warm pool?
Ryan: There are 2 nodes with ~30% free GPU memory and headroom for fractional slices. We can force new allocations via allocator flag `soft_quarantine=true` and route them to noisy-silo pools.
Oncall-Bot: Rolling allocator patch (alloc-service v172) that adds `soft_quarantine` in 5m. Deployment started.
Sre-Bot: Dash link: https://grafana/redwood/d/egress/tenant-9204 — NIC drops + tail latency correlate with TX queue growth. (snapshot attached)
Carmen: For immediate relief I'm going to mark tenant traffic on rack18-n2 and apply tc. command I'm testing:
```
sudo iptables -t mangle -A PREROUTING -m comment --comment "tenant9204" -m u32 --u32 "0>>22&0x3C@12=0xabcdef" -j MARK --set-mark 100
sudo tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 30
sudo tc class add dev eth0 parent 1: classid 1:100 htb rate 500mbit ceil 500mbit
sudo tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip handle 100 fw flowid 1:100
```
Ryan: I can apply that on rack18-n2 now. will report after 2min.
Devex-Sam: I'm pinging tenant contact (CC: @tenantops-9204) to warn them about temporary isolation and ask for their warmers to be rate-limited.
Ana: Remember rollback plan: if warmup fails we should let allocator reassign tasks back to original slice; keep careful watch on model SLI.
Sre-Bot: Also adding per-tenant NIC queue depth exporter to node-exporter (probe + small patch). will push a PR in 10m.
Ryan: Applied tc on rack18-n2 — immediate drop in tail latency to ~1.2x baseline, TX drops cleared. Watching for rebound. :thumbsup:
Carmen: Good. Capturing packet traces and inserting into PD ticket for postmortem. cost note: quarantine + re-routing bumped egress path by ~8% — will include in cost review.
Devex-Sam: Suggestion for follow-up: change warmer implementation to randomized backoff + global token bucket to avoid synchronized prefetch spikes. I'll draft a dev recommendation.
Oncall-Bot: Incident PD-1234 created and assigned to eng-infra.
Ana: Thanks all — keep the thread updated if tenant contact wants exemption or we see regen beyond 30m. (reaction :eyes:)
Carmen: Logging final state in ops notes and following up with tenant ops to schedule a rate-limited rollout for their warmer next week.
